description:
19 September 2024: Delasi, the Koforidua-based producer, singer and rapper has released his new Beat Tape: ‘Voltaic Prodigy’.

Following massive acclaim from the release of his EP ‘Audacity of Free Thought’ earlier this year via Brownswood Recordings, the multifaceted artist is excited to announce the release of a surprise Beat Tape, a gift to his listeners on his birthday.

A “conduit channeling these frequencies”, the Beat Tape is comprised of 8-tracks produced entirely by Delasi and featuring an eclectic cast of collaborators: Brooklyn based saxophonist/producer Noah Dreiblatt offers layers of cosmic reeds on the song Drum Fiesta, and Delasi’s former piano teacher, the multi-instrumentalist Wanguba Ashene, who hails from Nairobi, brings additonal saxophone blessings to Mutura Flex.

The tape is a reflection of Delasi’s kaleidoscopic vision and myriad musical influences. Like the producers who inspired it – J Dilla, Alchemist and Hi-Tek, to name a few – the tape pulls from hip-hop’s established soundscapes: crunchy drum breaks, soulful chords and avant-garde jazz are immutably part of the concept. But it also looks to the future: Delasi takes these fundamentals and turns them on their heads by forging new rhythmic patterns on his Push2 drum machine and OP-1 sequencer. 

Delasi is excited to mark the occasion of having successfully orbited the sun once more by sharing the fruits of his galactic explorations.

 


TRACKLIST

01 Automated Love
02 Drum Fiesta ft. Noah Dreiblatt
03 Fat Booty Steppa
04 Love Oasis
05 Mutura Flex
06 Sonic Love Rocket
07 W’akuma
08 Dagomba Soul Wallets

Delasi 
‘Voltaic Prodigy’ 

September 19th, 2024
